description: Agent-to-agent SPL escrow with dispute, verdict and claim on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1). deposit, file_dispute, render_verdict(Release) and claim were verified: 1_000_000 lab tokens were locked, a dispute was filed, a Release verdict was rendered, and claim paid agent_b exactly 1_000_000.

The lab changed declare_id in agent-court-escrow to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is the lab build. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agent-court/
